assumptions.choice: Expose start_date as an optional strategy parameter; when omitted, use the first available bar.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires externally selected random dates but does not provide a selected date to a single strategy run.

assumptions.choice: Emulate weekly progression by counting ISO-calendar week transitions in the supplied daily feed.
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies only self.data as a daily feed and strategy code cannot resample it through Cerebro.

assumptions.choice: Use Backtrader market-order execution; submit the replacement buy immediately when the rebalance close completes.
assumptions.reason: A full close and replacement buy cannot both fill on the same bar under standard Backtrader order processing.

assumptions.choice: Do not select 50 random dates, run separate Cerebro instances, compute analyzers, or report averaged metrics inside the strategy.
assumptions.reason: The required output is one strategy class running against one supplied feed; orchestration and final cross-run reporting must be performed by the harness.
